intro.title: A family home in Atamaría, open since 1986
intro.p1: In 1986, Jens and Reinhilde Dittler opened La Rusticana with the idea of offering Mediterranean cuisine in Atamaría. Today their daughter Nicole runs the house.
intro.p2: Terraces when the weather is fine, fireside rooms when it turns cooler, a children's play area and private parking: a place to have lunch, dinner and stay a while.

aboutPage.title: Forty years, one home
aboutPage.lead: La Rusticana was not created for tourists: it has been in Atamaría for forty years, with the same family behind it.

s1.title: 1986: opening day
s1.text: In 1986, a German couple, Jens and Reinhilde Dittler, opened La Rusticana in the Atamaría hills, near Los Belones. They wanted to offer Mediterranean cuisine in the area, with quality produce and international touches.

s2.title: Nicole takes the reins
s2.text: Their daughter Nicole took over the business and now runs the house. The family character shows: it is a restaurant where many guests return and where the welcome is still personal.

s3.title: Atamaría and La Manga Club
s3.text: The restaurant is in Paraje Atamaría, next to La Manga Club. Around the tables you will find neighbours from Cartagena and the surrounding area, residents and resort visitors from many countries, who have been welcomed in the same house for decades.

s4.title: The kitchen
s4.text: Mediterranean cuisine with international influences: homemade tapas and croquettes, rice dishes and paellas, meat, fish and pasta, alongside dishes from the Central European tradition such as schnitzel or beef Stroganoff.

timeline.text: Jens and Reinhilde Dittler open La Rusticana in Atamaría.
The ORM programme El Rompeolas devotes an episode to La Rusticana as part of its “Rutas gastronómicas por la Trimilenaria” (gastronomic routes through the Trimilenaria).
Forty years on, the house is still open and in the hands of the family.

privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how the personal data you provide when booking or contacting us is processed, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (RGPD/GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.text: Restaurante La Rusticana, Paraje Atamaría 76, 30385 Cartagena (Murcia). Email: larusticanarestaurant@outlook.es · Phone: +34 626 91 90 20. Company name and NIF/CIF (tax ID): to be confirmed by the owner.

sections.title: 2. What data we process and why
sections.text: Name, phone, email (optional), date, time, number of guests, preferred area, comments and any allergies you state, solely to manage your booking request and reply to you. If you contact us by phone, WhatsApp or email, we process the data you provide in order to deal with your enquiry.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
sections.text: Your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) when you submit the form, and the taking of pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6.1.b). If you mention allergies or intolerances, this data may relate to your health; we process it only to adapt our service, with your explicit consent when you submit it.

sections.title: 4. How your data travels
sections.text: This site does not store requests on a server of its own. When you submit the form, WhatsApp or your email app opens with the message ready to send or, if the restaurant activates a booking system, the request is sent to that system. WhatsApp involves Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. and, for email, the restaurant's provider (Microsoft Outlook).

sections.title: 5. Retention
sections.text: We keep the data for as long as necessary to manage the booking and, afterwards, for the legal limitation periods for possible liabilities. No profiling or automated decision-making takes place.

sections.title: 6. Recipients
sections.text: We do not disclose your data to third parties except where legally required. The providers mentioned act as processors or as independent controllers of their own services, according to their terms. If you load the Google map, Google receives technical data from your browser.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.text: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to larusticanarestaurant@outlook.es, with a copy of your ID if necessary. If you believe they have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, www.aepd.es).

sections.title: 8. Minors
sections.text: Bookings must be made by people aged 14 or over; for anyone younger, consent must be given by their parents or guardians.
